name: FTSE 100
summary: FTSE 100 near 10,346 on 20 Nov, 5.2% below its high and 4.9% lower on the week as global shares fell
state: The FTSE 100 was near 10,346 at 16:35 UTC on 20 Nov, 4.9% lower on the week and 5.2% below its 52-week high of 10,911, past the 5% Watch line (Yahoo Finance). Its largest daily fall of the past five sessions was 1.8%, inside the 2.5% single-day line. The fall follows the global equity sell-off that took the S&P 500 into a correction on 19 Nov (Saxo).
for_you: UK shares are in a moderate pullback. Pensions and funds with UK equities are exposed to further swings while global markets stay volatile.

sources.title: Saxo — Asian stocks tumble after Wall Street's sixth straight decline
